excerpt: With a discography approaching 200 releases, it might be tempting to imagine saxophonist Ivo Perelman as a kind of jazz gunfighter, in the lineage of Charlie Parker or Coleman Hawkins, stepping into one cutting contest after another. But that image misses the mark. Perelman's recordings are rarely about competition. Instead, they are grounded in creation, collaboration and deep musical partnership.
_cn_summary: 萨克斯手Ivo Perelman（拥有近200张专辑的资深即兴演奏家）在《Trifecta》中与吉他手Marc Ribot、低音提琴手William Morris及Sharp合作，呈现完全即兴的自由爵士风格，摒弃传统的对决式独奏，聚焦创作、协作与深度音乐伙伴关系。专辑声音层次丰富、充满张力，四位音乐家的默契配合使每一次演奏都呈现出独特的即兴生成与情感张力。该作值得关注的亮点在于其对即时创作的高度重视，以及在自由爵士语境下展现的细腻对话与层次感。

excerpt: On Peel/Mondo, two distinctive voices sport in adventurous communion. Polish pianist Marta Warelis and Argentinean saxophonist Ada Rave first met as part of the fertile Amsterdam scene. As a result, they know each other well, so the empathy and highly attuned responsiveness they display on these six collective inventions from a 2024 concert performance comes as little surprise.
_cn_summary: Ada Rave（阿根廷萨克斯）与Marta Warelis（波兰钢琴）均是阿姆斯特丹实验音乐场景的资深成员，长期在现场即兴中互相切磋，形成了高度默契的合作关系。《Peel/Mondo》收录2024年现场演出的六段即兴，两位音乐家在自由爵士与当代即兴的交叉口上，把钢琴的冲击式敲击与萨克斯的呼吸式旋律紧密交织，形成既细腻又具冲击力的声部对话。专辑标题暗示“层层剥离”与“世界碎片”，展示了两种迥异背景的音色在高度响应中产生的统一感，是近年来欧洲实验现场录音中兼具创新与情感张力的佳作。

excerpt: Taken together, Fading Bright and Litchfield reveal the emotional and conceptual breadth possible within contemporary ambient music when approached with sincerity and imagination. Both artists resist easy categorization or formulaic structures, choosing instead to create deeply immersive worlds shaped by texture, emotion, and atmosphere.
_cn_summary: 《memorysound/Fading Bright & Spectrical/Litchfield — 2View》收录了两位国内ambient/electronica制作人Fading Bright与Litchfield的最新创作，二人均在氛围与实验电子领域深耕多年，擅长将合成纹理、自然采集音与极简结构交织成沉浸式声场。专辑呈现细腻且暗暖的当代氛围音景：Fading Bright以柔和的渐暗声浪展现光影交织的情绪转折，Litchfield则利用低沉脉冲与空间回响营造沉思式暗色氛围；两者均摒弃公式化编排，以情感驱动的纹理和细致的动态变化突显听感亮点。该作品在层次感与氛围张力上兼具实验性与可听性，适合安静环境下的深度聆听。

excerpt: Norwegian bassist and composer Jo Berger Myhre approaches patterns, drones, and general ideas with curiosity on Penta, his third release for Rare Noise Records. The album, where cultures and disciplines intersect with remarkable fluidity, reunites the core quartet from Live Maneuvers (2023). Myhre's music pulses with a vital, searching energy, exploring the fragile spaces between breath and sound. His patterned imprints, often reinforced by adapt post-production, casts an occasional spell.
_cn_summary: Jo Berger Myhre 是挪威低音提琴手兼作曲家，Rare Noise Records 的第三张专辑《Penta》重新召集 Live Maneuvers 四重奏，以简约音型与持续的 Drone 为骨架，辅以电子后制构建层次丰富的实验声场。专辑专注捕捉呼吸与声音之间的脆弱间隙，以脉冲式的探索能量与偶发的咒语式回响形成独特的暗潮氛围。其在即兴与结构之间的平衡以及后制带来的音型刻印，使其在当代实验爵士/噪声领域尤为值得关注。

title: Melvins & Napalm Death — Savage Imperial Death March
author: Roger Batty
excerpt: When I first heard about this collaboration between The Melvins and Napalm Death, I thought I had a good idea how this was going to sound — but aside from a few tracks, this album sounds nothing like I was expecting. And I think it's fair to say that for the most part, Savage Imperial Death March is very much a dive into the odd, off-kilter, and downright weird. To say Savage Imperial Death March was very much of a weird and wonderful surprise is an understatement. Apparently, the album was a fifty/ fifty collab, and together they conjured up such an unpredictable and keenly experimental yet entertaining record, which really is unlike anything else.
label: Ipecac Recordings
_cn_summary: 《Savage Imperial Death March》由美国污泥金属先驱The Melvins与英国碾核传奇Napalm Death各占一半创作，两位极端金属老将把Melvins标志性的慢沉嗡鸣与Napalm Death的高速碎拍交织，形成既沉重又狂躁、频现不规则节拍和怪异采样的奇异音景。专辑的听感亮点在于两支乐队的风格相互穿插、突兀的音墙与突变速率的安排，使整张作品充满不可预料的转折与实验感。作为一次跨流派、50/50的合作，这张专辑打破了传统极端金属的疆界，提供罕见且极具实验性的冲击，值得喜欢污泥、碾核及实验噪音的乐迷重点关注。

title: Sunn O)))))) — Sunn O))))))
author: Roger Batty
excerpt: After spending the last decade and a half or so trying to expand upon, cross-genre pollinate, and generally do something different with their monolithic sound, this tenth studio album from prime doom droners Sunn O)))))) finds them very much returning to their roots, but with way more layers of guitars and pure crushing weightiness about it. When I first got this album, it barely left my stereo, and at points I had to literally forcefully remove it to play other stuff. Not only is self-titled a true & proper return to form from Sunn O)))))), but it's one of 2026's highlights.
label: Sub Pop
_cn_summary: 美国极端嗡鸣/厄运金属二人组Sunn O))))))在过去的十五年里频繁跨界实验，这张同名专辑《Sunn O))))))》却彻底回归他们标志性的极简嗡鸣美学，以层层堆叠的吉他失真、低沉的嗡鸣基调和极端的压迫感重新塑造“单体”声响。专辑几乎摒弃传统旋律，专注于延音的持续叠加与低频冲击，使听者在长时间沉浸时感受到持续的重压与空间的扩张感。作为2026年的重要作品，它被评价为Sunn O))))))的回归之作，也是当年极端金属/实验音乐现场最值得关注的亮点之一。

excerpt: After four years, North London's For Breakfast return with Longer Than Spring, an LP trading the murky, sprawling friction of the seven-piece band's roots for a leaner, solo-led architecture. It's a sophisticated if occasionally sanitised evolution; while the band's signature virtuosity remains, it is now tethered to the singular narrative of vocalist and keys player Maya Harrison.
_cn_summary: 来自北伦敦的七人编制乐队For Breakfast在沉寂四年后发行《Longer Than Spring》，抛弃了以往层层交叠的嘈杂张力，转而采用更精简、以单人叙事为主导的编排。专辑在保持乐队标志性的技术精湛的同时，聚焦键盘手兼主唱Maya Harrison的独白式演唱，音色呈现精致而略带刻意的“净化”感，使听感在细腻与略显平淡之间徘徊。

excerpt: Mimika Orchestra has released Medzotermina, its fifth studio album. The 20-piece ensemble, conducted by composer Mak Murtić, recorded most of the nine-track album at Vatroslav Lisinski Concert Hall. Founded in London in 2010 and later based in Zagreb, Croatia, Mimika Orchestra amalgamates world music traditions with contemporary jazz. Medzotermina convinces with its mix of elegant folk-rooted vocals, powerful ensemble horns and virtuosic solos. The group previewed the album with 'Dišpet,'…
_cn_summary: 伦敦创立、现驻克罗地亚萨格勒布的20人乐团Mimika Orchestra在作曲家Mak Murtić指挥下，于瓦特罗斯拉夫·利辛斯基音乐厅完成录音，推出第九张专辑《Medzotermina》。专辑融合世界民族音乐与当代爵士，以优雅的民间根声乐、有力的合奏号角以及技术精湛的独奏为亮点，呈现层次丰富且具仪式感的声场。先行单曲《Dišpet》已凸显乐团将民谣旋律与即兴爵士结构相互渗透的独特风格。

excerpt: Lamine Cissokho is a Senegalese kora player and backing vocalist from Casamance. He comes from a griot family whose musical lineage dates to the 14th century. His father, Sana Cissokho, introduced him to the kora in childhood; his great-uncle, kora master Lalo Keba Drame, later became another key influence. Cissokho first performed traditional Manding repertoire. He later developed original compositions that connect Manding tradition with jazz, Middle Eastern music, and Nordic folk. Between…
_cn_summary: 塞内加尔卡萨芒斯的kora演奏家Lamine Cissokho出身于可追溯至14世纪的griot家族，父亲Sana Cissokho和叔父、kora大师Lalo Keba Drame是其主要师承，使他在传统Manding曲目上功底扎实。专辑以kora的丝弦音色为基调，融合爵士即兴段落、中东调式的微分音以及北欧民谣的和声层次，形成跨文化的声场与多变的节奏结构。Cissokho细腻的指弹技法配合低声部的合唱，让音乐在保持griot叙事性的同时兼具现代跨界音乐的流动感，呈现出一次值得关注的传统与现代对话。

tags: instrumental, experimental, ambient, drone, field recording, modern composition
excerpt: Imagine living in the “best town,” a rural community of friendly neighbors surrounded by natural beauty, and then being forcibly displaced so the government could make nuclear bombs. This is what happened to the shellshocked citizens of Ellenton, South Carolina in 1951. A research project at the nearby Savannah River, testing birds to see if they were still radioactive (they were) prompted the members of Magic Tuber Stringband to compose Heavy Water, a soundtrack to a centuries-spanning tragedy
_cn_summary: Magic Tuber Stringband 是一支来自美国波特兰的实验性老派弦乐队，擅长将阿巴拉契亚民谣与即兴氛围音景相融合。专辑《Heavy Water》以密集的弓弦、滑音班卓与低沉的嗡鸣声构建出阴郁的声场，配合叙事性结构再现了1951年南卡罗来纳州埃伦顿镇因核弹研发被迫搬迁的历史悲剧，突出其电影感与对社会创伤的深刻关注。

album: The Second Coming Was A Moonrise
tags: instrumental, experimental, ambient, drone, field recording, modern composition
excerpt: What would happen if one were to mix LSD with fundamentalist Christianity? Hammock‘s Marc Byrd learned the answer when watching the moonrise and mistaking it for the apocalypse. Looking back, Byrd writes of “letting go of toxic shame and bad religion, while holding onto what is good, beautiful and true.” Rather than lamenting the delayed rapture, he writes, “Seeing and experiencing a moonrise is a miracle in itself.” The Second Coming Was a Moonrise reimagines Christianity as a religion of seeki
_cn_summary: Hammock（美国纳什维尔的后摇/氛围二人组）在《The Second Coming Was A Moonrise》中以宏大、层叠的吉他与合成器构建出星际般的音墙，结合梦幻的编曲，将宗教救赎与宇宙沉思交织成独特的声响画卷。专辑以“月升”象征从toxic shame与僵化神学中解脱，亮点在于细腻的钢琴点缀与戏剧性的动态起伏，在压抑的宗教阴影与光的温柔之间提供情感释放。该作概念完整、声音细节丰富，把灵性主题与现代后摇语言有机结合，值得在静谧的夜里反复聆听。

tags: instrumental, experimental, ambient, drone, field recording, modern composition
excerpt: You can’t go home again, writes Thomas C. Wolfe in Look Homeward, Angel. Paris-based artist Aho Ssan (Niamké Désiré) experienced this feeling of disconnection when he visited Ghana, his ancestral home. The friction between home and homeland led to The Sun Turned Black, an intense and visceral LP characterized by the physicality of sound. One can hear him working through dissonance, sculpting impressions as if they were cascades of sound. At the direct center of the album is “The Children of Nois
_cn_summary: Aho Ssan（本名 Niamké Désiré）是常驻巴黎、拥有西非血统的实验电子音乐人，他在探访祖先居住的加纳后产生的“回不去家”的疏离感，直接驱动了《The Sun Turned Black》这张作品的诞生。专辑以极具身体感的低音冲击与不协和音为核心，融合现场录音、工业噪声、环境氛围和细碎的旋律纹理，声音层层叠加如同倾泻的瀑布，呈现出既压抑又富有张力的听觉体验。中心曲目《The Children of Noise》以其雕塑式的结构与情绪起伏，凸显出 Aho Ssan 在实验电子与后殖民叙事之间的独特视角，使整张 LP 成为近年来值得关注的噪音与音乐边界探索之作。

tags: instrumental, experimental, ambient, drone, field recording, modern composition
excerpt: Artwork by Mariia Prymachenko This episode of Ukrainian Field Notes comes to you from Lviv, where I have been attending the Lviv Media Forum, whose theme this year is Reality Under Attack: Flight, Freeze, or Fight? Alongside the talks, there were also video installations, including You Shouldn’t Have to See This (2024) by Yarema Malashchuk and Roman Khimei [UFN XXIX], who filmed sleeping children who had been forcibly taken to Russian territory and later returned to Ukraine, foregrounding one of
_cn_summary: 《Ukrainian Field Notes LV — Unknown》是乌克兰“现场笔记”系列在利沃夫的最新章节，由当地媒体论坛策划并邀请匿名艺术家参与录制，聚焦战争阴影下的城市声景。专辑融合街头环境音、传统民谣片段与电子噪声实验，以低频嗡鸣、细碎人声和空间混响构建压抑而坚韧的氛围，突出“现实受袭”主题的沉浸式听觉冲击。值得注意的亮点包括封面的Mariia Prymachenko民间画作以及与同名影像装置中被迫迁移儿童声音的呼应，使听觉与视觉叙事形成强烈共振。

excerpt: Saxophonist and composer Sean Imboden's Large Ensemble springs forth from America's heartland—more specifically, the thriving capital city of Indianapolis, Indiana. The ensemble is indeed large—18 members strong—and Imboden gives every one of them serious work to do on the group's second recording, Uncharted Realms, unraveling a series of colorful and adventurous charts written with the ensemble's skill-sets in mind.
_cn_summary: Sean Imboden 是一位出生于印第安纳州首府印第安纳波利斯的中音萨克斯手兼作曲家，他领衔的 18 人大型爵士合奏团（Large Ensemble）在《Uncharted Realms》中呈现了充满活力的现代大乐队之声。专辑融合了摇滚、放克与古典等多元元素，编曲紧凑、色调绚丽且具冒险精神，每位成员都有独立的高光段落，整体呈现出高度的合奏默契与个人表达的平衡。值得关注的是，这种以印第安纳波利斯为据点、兼具技术深度与实验性的创作，让《Uncharted Realms》成为当代大编制爵士现场的一颗亮点。

title: Pig Peasant — Ossabaw Island Hog
author: Roger Batty
excerpt: Ossabaw Island Hog is a twenty-minute slice of choppy and bass-pummelling walling from this Old Town, Maine-based project. Throughout the track has an oddly soothing quality about it, and I could have easily played this for another twenty, thirty, or even forty minutes. Built around a chugging 'n' blunt low end, surrounded by choppy, slightly hiss-bound Mids. The whole 'wall' has a decidedly muddy/woozy feel about it, and really, this pulls you deeper into the 'wall' — to fully enjoy the textural patterns on offer here.
label: Dying Monolith HNW
_cn_summary: Ossabaw Island Hog 来自美国缅因州老城，是一支主打低音冲击与墙面式音墙的独立项目。其全长约二十分钟的《Pig Peasant》以强劲的低频敲击为根基，辅以略带嘶哑的高中频切割，整体呈现浓稠、泥泞且略带眩晕的质感。虽然音墙厚重，却拥有奇特的抚慰感，纹理层次丰富，可让人长时间沉浸而不感疲劳，是低音实验噪声爱好者值得关注之作。

excerpt: Mastered and recorded at Elektronmusikstudion (EMS) in Stockholm between 2024 and 2026, I Det Vassa Ljuset is based on close-miking of organic materials such as wood, metal, stone, and glass. These recordings have then been processed and transformed into software instruments that can be played live. Released on her own label Istid Records, I Det Vassa Ljuset is available digitally and on cassette.
_cn_summary: 瑞典实验音乐人Vera V Almgren在斯德哥尔摩Elektronmusikstudion（EMS）完成录制与母带处理，其背景聚焦于现场电子与声学材料的交互。新专辑《I Det Vassa Ljuset》通过近距离录音采集木头、金属、石头、玻璃等有机材料的声波，并将其加工成可实时演奏的软件乐器，形成一种有机‑电子融合的声音——细腻的木纹共鸣、金属脆响与石质颗粒相互交织。现场演奏时这些软件乐器会产生动态的渐变音色，从低沉的嗡鸣到尖锐的金属撞击，层次丰富且具触觉感；同时，专辑以独立厂牌Istid Records的数字版和磁带发行，为听众提供难得的实体聆听媒介。

album: Hollan Holmes :: The Sanctity of Rust (Spotted Peccary Music)
excerpt: Hollan Holmes delivers a conceptual ambient-electronic album that energizes beauty, while considering decay, aging, and the passage of time. This could act in a sonic parallel to Holmes' visual art, celebrating the unconventional elegance of oxidation and endurance.
_cn_summary: Hollan Holmes 是美国跨足视觉艺术与电子音乐的双栖创作者，擅长以自然腐蚀、时间流逝为灵感进行概念性创作。《The Sanctity of Rust》在氛围电子的基础上，融合了金属腐蚀声、颗粒噪声与合成器层叠的纹理，呈现出“美化衰败”的沉浸式声场；其最亮眼的听感在于柔软的氛围铺垫、尖锐的金属碎屑与悠长的旋律回响交织，既有宁静诗意又具工业质感，展现出高保真音响下的细节张力，值得在耳机或影院级系统上细细聆听。

album: Concert Review: Brad Mehldau Trio at the Ridgefield Playhouse
excerpt: Pianist Brad Mehldau, during a trio concert at the Ridgefield Playhouse in Connecticut, made a point of mentioning his West Hartford origins to a generous and welcoming crowd. He was four tunes in when he finally picked up the mic, first to say, "On drums tonight, Jorge Rossy." To this aging listener it felt like the old days with the original Mehldau rhythm section of Rossy and bassist Larry Grenadier, which took the jazz world pretty much by storm in the mid-'90s and early '00s.
_cn_summary: 布拉德·梅尔道出生于康涅狄格州西哈特福德，90年代至2000年代初与鼓手 Jorge Rossy、贝斯手 Larry Grenadier 组成的标志性三重奏在里奇菲尔德剧院现场重聚，重新点燃了当时的“风暴”式即兴能量。演出中梅尔道的细腻、旋律驱动的钢琴语汇与 Rossy 轻柔而富有节奏感的鼓点、Grenadier 稳定的低音交织，形成兼具怀旧感与现代感的音响层次。最值得关注的是乐团在曲目安排上的灵活转换——从经典现代爵士到古典独奏元素，让三重奏在紧密对话中展现丰富的情感张力。

album: Book Review: Melvin Gibbs’s How Black Music Took Over the World
excerpt: First, full disclosure: I have written six books, since the 1990s, on the history of American music, most with an emphasis on the way race has shaped so much of our cultural history. Second: I know that Melvin Gibbs’s How Black Music Took Over the World (Basic Books) is about “the world,” not just the U.S. Of course it’s hard to separate the two, since American culture is emulated, copied and appropriated everywhere.
_cn_summary: Melvin Gibbs 是美国著名的低音提琴手与实验音乐人，长期活跃于自由爵士、先锋摇滚与放克的交叉领域，曾与 John Zorn、Roy Nathanson 等艺术家合作，以极具冲击力的低音线条与即兴精神著称。《How Black Music Took Over the World》以厚重的低音为基底，融合即兴爵士、实验电子、口语叙事以及非洲、灵魂、放克等多元音乐纹理，构建出一幅跨越美国与全球的黑人音乐全景图。专辑最引人注目的是将政治性自述与强劲的节拍即兴交织，使听众在感受音乐冲击力的同时，亦能清晰体会到黑人音乐对世界流行文化的深远影响。

excerpt: The Mon: Songs of Embrace Urlo, the bassist, keyboardist, and lead vocalist from the Italian psychedelic metal band Ufomammut, has a solo project titled The Mon. The most recent release, from March of this year, is titled Songs of Embrace . Itâs meant to be a companion album to last autumnâs Songs of Abandon . The albumâs structures are very different, however. While Songs of Abandon featured acoustic tunes with vocals, Songs of Embrace is entirely instrumental and highly electronic. âWh
_cn_summary: 《Songs of Embrace》出自Ufomammut低音/键盘/主唱Urlo的个人计划The Mon，延续前作《Songs of Abandon》的概念，却在编曲上彻底转向纯电子器乐。专辑大量采用模块合成器、脉冲式电子纹理和层次感强烈的空间混响，营造出带有暗潮感的迷幻声墙，兼具工业节奏的脉冲与空灵的延音。与前作的民谣原声和人声形成鲜明对比，这张全程无唱的电子作品更像是一段沉浸式的音景实验，值得在耳机或现场声场中细细捕捉细节。

album: Against The Grain: London's DIY sound systems
excerpt: As music venues across London struggle with mounting costs, sound system events are putting down roots in community centres and other ad hoc spaces, writes Derek Walmsley in The Wire 508 It’s a winter evening in Stratford, East London, and past the cemetery, just down from the corner shop, on a quiet street with terraced houses on one side and a council block on the other, reggae sound systems are battling for supremacy. In the spartan main room at Hibiscus Community Centre, home to the local Ca
_cn_summary: 《Against The Grain: London’s DIY Sound Systems》是一张由伦敦东区（如Stratford）牙买加后裔与本地实验音乐人组成的DIY声系统团队制作的现场合辑，聚焦Hibiscus社区中心等非商业空间的现场声部对决。唱片以现场dub、雷鬼声系统混音为核心，低频厚重的底鼓与碎拍结合模拟磁带的颗粒感，营造出极具沉浸感的低音冲击与现场噪音的原始氛围。该专辑突出了后疫情时代社区驱动的声系统文化复兴，记录了非正规空间的声音实验与多元音乐传统的碰撞融合，堪称观察当代地下音乐社群创新的重要窗口。

album: It's Nice To See A Lake In Your Eyes
excerpt: It's fairly common practice these days for artists to collaborate with each other over long distances. Musical stems are shared instantly, the old-fashioned studio room no longer a necessity in the digital age when musicians can guest on each other's records without ever meeting. Carol Maia and Jeremy Gustin have created an album with thousands of miles between Carol's home in Rio de Janeiro and Jeremy's in Brooklyn but have done so with a rare alchemy. Intimate, quietly funky and transcendental in its poetic beauty, 'it's nice to see a lake in your eyes' is a remarkable record.
_cn_summary: Carol Maia 是里约热内卢的歌手兼词曲作者，Jeremy Gustin 则是定居布鲁克林的打击乐手兼制作人，两人跨越大西洋的远程合作让《It’s Nice To See A Lake In Your Eyes》在音乐与情感上都充满跨文化的碰撞。专辑以巴西节奏为根基，加入轻巧的 funk 律动与氛围化的声景，呈现出亲密且带有诗意的聆听感，其中同名曲以层叠的人声与细腻的打击乐纹理尤为突出。

excerpt: Sixteen years after its inception, Seu Jorge presents The Other Side as an invitation into some of the most captivating styles of Brazilian music, MPB, jazz, samba and bossa nova. It is also a deeply personal statement from Seu Jorge. Jorge treats Brazilian musical tradition with reverence, passion and restless curiosity. Masterfully produced by Mario Caldato Jr. and beautifully orchestrated by composer and multi-instrumentalist Miguel Atwood-Ferguson, the record offers elegant orchestral…
_cn_summary: 塞乌·豪尔赫（Seu Jorge）——以《Life Aquatic》配乐中葡萄牙语翻唱而广为人知的巴西歌手——时隔十六年推出《The Other Side》，将MPB、爵士、桑巴与波萨诺瓦四种本土音律交织，以个人化的视角重新诠释巴西音乐传统。专辑由曾为野兽男孩等打造经典的制作人马里奥·卡尔达托 Jr. 执掌制作，并交由作曲家兼多乐器演奏家米格尔·阿特伍德‑弗格森进行交响编曲，呈现出弦乐层层递进、打击乐与键盘细腻呼应的精致音墙。最大亮点在于豪尔赫柔软的声线与交响编排之间的对比——既有桑巴节奏的律动感，又保留了波萨诺瓦的柔和抒情，让人感受到传统底蕴与现代编曲的微妙平衡。

excerpt: Born from two years of research at Rutgers University, Attunement finds singer-songwriter Heidi Martin tracing the life, work and journals of jazz artist and civil rights activist Abbey Lincoln. The result is anything but a conventional tribute; it is more a channelling of Lincoln's spirit, one that has pushed Martin to some of the most ambitious compositional work of her career.

Not every pianist wants to make a lot of noise. Sebastian Jakobsen Testa's Reverence is more a meditation than a jamboree. In the minimalist vein, these six tracks still have much to offer. There is a sleekness as well as a gauzy quality. The use of space between the chords and runs helps draw in the listener's attention.

Caylie Davis grew up in Eugene, Oregon, playing trumpet in a town not exactly known for avant-garde-leaning jazz before making her way to New York to enroll at the Manhattan School of Music. There, she studied under Ingrid Jensen, Nadje Noordhuis and Jon Faddis—three players who, between them, cover a wide stylistic range. Davis casts an even broader net.

title: Necrotik Fissure — Was
author: Roger Batty
excerpt: Here's seventy-eight minutes' worth of barrenly searing 'n' crudely whizzing HNW from this Hungarian project. Necrotik Fissure has been active since the early 2010's, been both prolific and unflinchingly extreme in its releasing of the walled noise form. The single track is a rapid and totally engulfing affair — thick weave bringing together a constantly rolling 'n' rearing bass tone, a whizzing grind, with a few cluttering/baying subtones. Was is another longform, searing, and totally unforgiving example of the wall noise form.

This album is a bit of an enigma wrapped in a riddle but a somewhat familiar one. Mana ERG is Bruno De Angelis, having released albums since 1990, both under his own name and Mana ERG. Bruno is also one half of LHAM with Giuseppe Verticchio. If I had to assign a simple genre category for 'Concealed Under A Strange Tongue,' I'd call it Experimental Ambient, but this is a long way off from any kind of conventional ambient music. The album was mastered by Chain D.L.K.'s own Marc Urselli. The album consists of 12 tracks that seem to resemble some type of fever dream. Bruno describes the album as twelve instrumentals blending obscure rock textures with cinematic soundscapes.

Lost Hope Society doesn’t deal in easy optimism. Instead, it locates hope as a kind of underlying signal—constant, even when masked by noise. Like Midsommar, it uses brightness to reveal shadow, and in doing so, turns discomfort into clarity.

Two of my favorite sonic sculptors converge as F~M, alias of Roel Funcken and Jeroen Bax (aka exm), shaping Fose into four extended chapters that warp and reassemble rhythmic glitch fragments, threaded with fluid collisions of bass pressure, flickering bleeps, and meticulous sound design.

Accelerate doesn’t chase nostalgia or novelty in isolation—it integrates both. Poladroïd works within electro’s lineage while actively reconfiguring its edges, balancing discipline with invention. The result is a concise but fully realized statement: technically sharp, atmospherically rich, and rhythmically compelling throughout.

The resulting experience of Sorry I Didn't Realize feels untethered from trends or nostalgia bait, instead standing defiantly above contemporaries as both tribute and evolution — easily deserving placement near summit of any Best of 2026 conversation.

title: Raté — Bruit De Fond
author: Roger Batty
excerpt: Bruit De Fond is an example of churning walled noise nihilism from Bordeaux's Raté. It's a single thirty-four-minute track, which remains terminal hope-battering & unbreakable over its full length. The track is built around a thick, full and rapid blend of constantly rolling bass churn, choppy mids, and cluttering hiss-bound subtones. It makes for a very clamouring and airless 'wall' — which brought to mind having a panic attack in rush hour city traffic.

Rasmussen incorporates his own vocals more than ever, weaving them seamlessly into intricate electronic textures as he expands his sound into new territory while retaining the subtle restraint that has defined his work.

With Bitches Blues—a clear nod to Miles Davis' Bitches Brew—powerhouse Norwegian guitarist Hedvig Mollestad explores terrain that is noticeably less abrasive than on her previous releases. Technically accomplished yet rarely exhilarating, Bitches Blues leaves the impression of an album that could have dug deeper emotionally and texturally in order to achieve a more compelling result.

artist: Ava Bahari, Santtu-Matias Rouvali, Gothenburg Symphony Orchestra
excerpt: Ava Bahari's technique is unquestionably brilliant. Every technical difficulty is fully mastered: perfect intonation, awkward shifts flawlessly managed, the opening movement's difficult cadenza thrillingly dispatched. Throughout the concerto she draws a wonderful variety of colors from her 1694 Stradivarius 'Ovcharov.' Yet after repeated listening, the reviewer came away impressed but rarely moved, preferring more heart-on-sleeve interpretations like Janine Jansen or Vilde Frang.

Irish violinist Gráinne Brady has released Back and Forth, a new album of traditional and contemporary fiddle music that reflects her roots in Ireland and her years in Glasgow. The collection features tunes she has known since childhood, as well as music developed through sessions and festivals on both sides of the Irish Sea. Throughout the record, Brady shifts from brisk reels and driving jigs to quieter, melodic passages. Brady is joined by Michael Biggins on piano, Innes White on guitar, and…

Though air hangs all around us, it's usually imperceptible. But when it moves, we hear it. A gale rustles the leaves, yielding a bristling crunch; a gentle breeze swirls in the atmosphere, leaving a faint hum in its wake. Like the shifting winds, TAK Ensemble's virtuosic performances are in a constant state of change. Over the last 13 years, the group has established themselves as adventurers, having premiered hundreds of new pieces that embrace the unexpected. Between the Air, their latest and eighth album, exemplifies this spirit of experimentation. The album of musical extremes foregrounds texture, using many extended techniques and the full spectrum of timbres and pitches possible on the mixed-quintet's instruments.

Guitarist Phil Sargent maintains dual prominence in academic circles and the US jazz scene, serving as a respected music educator at New England institutions. This solo project demonstrates his commitment to the jazz tradition.

This is gentle, relaxing music, carefully crafted and played with a deceptive ease. Described as folksy with hypnotic, lyrical beauty — full of repeated motifs. Originally trained on saxophone but this album is dominated by a variety of plucked string instruments.

Berlin-based jazz duo (Dhanya Langer and Max Scholl) maintain a tranquil soundscape, capturing live studio energy and natural imperfections while retaining polished production. Fuses contemporary jazz, soul, hip-hop, and electronic music.

album: Folk Round-up (Old Spot, Wayward Jane & more)
excerpt: Essential folk releases from the England, Ireland, Scotland & Wales featuring Anna McLuckie, Honey and the Bear, Wayward Jane, Old Spot and Ali Levack. Ali Levack's self-titled debut opens with Rory Matheson's plush electric keys; Old Spot II fuses Appalachian with Irish, English and European traditions; Wayward Jane's Neptune is their clawhammer banjo, fiddle, guitar and bass augmented by cittern, harmonium and an Uzbek doyra; Honey and the Bear's A Wish and a Tide draws on the myths and legends of Suffolk.

album: Beethoven: The Sonatas for Piano and Cello
excerpt: Paul Watkins and Alessio Bax's complete set of Beethoven's Cello Sonatas follows a succession of notable cycles reviewed in these pages in recent years. They offer a compelling journey through Beethoven's stylistic evolution, effectively tracing his development across his three distinct periods. High-quality sound engineering further elevates these five readings, magnifying a performance already distinguished by its depth, sensitivity, and formidable musicianship.

What does culture, or entertainment, mean right now? And should we be scared of such things, in the mediums they currently present themselves in? Laibach's new long player, Musick, often toys with such questions.

JR Moores listens to some alt rock releases and has a bone to pick with the chief Foo Fibber. Dave Grohl is on the charm offensive. I know what you're thinking. That's exactly what he's been on for the past 30 years.
